pr_title: Fix to prevent AcceptDialog and children class taking over main window
pr_body:
Potential fix for #58229.  
`AcceptDialog` and other windows with `set_exclusive(true)` take over main window when set visible in editor and makes it uninteractable.
Made behavior follow that of `Popup` (without `set_exclusive`) when in editor.  
Not sure if this is the desired behavior when editing but should remain the same outside of it.

*Bugsquad edit: This closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/51362.*

issue_context.title: Enabling the Visible property on an exclusive AcceptDialog causes the editor to no longer receive mouse events (DisplayServer regression)
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

3177da1d053a6132668e12a8d8af82366f5c4ac9

### System information

Windows 10

### Issue description

The editor will freeze forever(without error spamming) if the user touches a `Visible` property of the `ConfirmationDialog` in the inspector:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3036176/128600547-044c4fea-1b16-4560-b518-0fdf1842ee2f.png)


### Steps to reproduce

Create a `ConfirmationDialog` and touch this property. 

### Minimal reproduction project

Too trivial to reproduce.
comments:
